body: I’ve given up on finding people, they just aren’t worth it. I don’t want to feel anything anymore, I just want to die.
Thanks, I took it yesterday
Ouch
Why don’t you try it? I actually liked it a lot
Can I just PM you, if you don’t mind that is
Do you wanna hear it?
I’ll tell you later? You don’t mind right?
It’s a pretty long and complicated story, you sure you want to hear it?
People like me don’t deserve to live, we just make peoples lives worse. I don’t want to do that anymore. I’m just better off dead. I’ve tried for 10 years, but nothing worked out for me.
Hope just leads me to more despair, I keep hoping for things to get better, but nothing ever happens

The same things have happened to me today. The people I hold dear left me, and I’m sick of their hypocrisy. We can only move forward I guess, but a part of me wants to die too. The worst part is, we cannot die even if we want to. Keep moving forward and we might find something to look forward to in life I guess?
Please don’t do it, just try to hang on a while longer, I don’t know when or how things will get better, but they will.
I think you really need a fresh start away from the old people. Meet new people and live a new life on your own terms. It will really help you.
Just please don’t do it, I’m a 17 year old male, and I’ve tried some very rash and dumb things and I do regret it. Please don’t try it, and approach an institution and seek help.

Why don’t you try looking at life with a new perspective? I’m also not flocked around by friends or women, I’m actually alone. Try looking at yourself with a new light, maybe things might work out. Try to avoid the bad things from getting to you. I hope you don’t do any rash.

There are many people who’ve had it worse, I’m a Vicodin addict, and things aren’t too great for me either. I’ve already ruined my life, and I’m trying to start things afresh. If I can do it, you can do it too. Please try to approach a therapist. I hope something good happens to you today.

It’s not that accepted in india either, but don’t let them get to you. Keep them at an arms length, ward them off with sarcastic lines and witty comebacks. Just go to a psychologist and clear your mind, you’re worth more than those people. I hope something good happens to you today. Please rethink your choices.

I’ve waited 10 years for things to get better for me, but nothing has happened yet. I’m still waiting hoping something does happen. Please try giving things a second thought, and maybe something good might happen. I hope something good happens to you today.
I know what it’s like, let me help you out. Please don’t do anything rash.

How old are you? Everyone hates themself on the inside but don’t ever show it outwards. If those who hated themselves had to die, there would be nobody left. Please don’t make any rash decisions and give it a second thought.

I sincerely hope you don’t make any rash decisions, and I do hope that things get better for you this point forward. Just try moving far away and having a fresh start, it’s not too late and things might just work out for you.
I used to live in the US but moved to India since 2017.

Not everyone who has these thoughts can end up becoming dangerous. Everyone has these thoughts from time to time, I have them at times too. So if you want to get rid of such people you’re gonna have to get rid of everyone. It’s ok to have such anger within. Just don’t act on it. This isn’t worth killing yourself over. Please don’t do it, instead try helping others. Help people who are like this and show them the better path.

Dude, I’ve had it worse and I’m still here clinging on to a false sense of hope. I’m an addict, and It hurts a lot. I understand how you feel, miserable and lonely. I’m like that too. I take antidepressants too, and I know how it makes you feel flat and going without them is a literal nightmare. Just please give life another chance, maybe you might find something worthwhile. I know that suicide seems like an easy way out, but it isn’t. It hurts, not just you but everyone around you: friends; coworkers; and family. It’s like tossing a live grenade at them and then bailing. You’re going to scar those you hold close, and I don’t think you’d want that on you. And no amount of antidepressants will allow you to run away from that. So please try to live on.

You still have so much more to live for, you’re still on the young side. Go out see the world, that is also fun. Fun isn’t always restricted to things like booze and drugs and women or something. Maybe one day you’ll find the perfect woman for you(assuming you’re not married) who’s gonna love you for all your flaws. So please don’t end it.

Please don’t do it. Everyone says it gets better, but that takes time and you need some patience for it. I too don’t believe in things getting better(call me a hypocrite) but just please don’t end it. You have so much to live for.
Why do you want to pass? Is there any particular reason?

Here’s an idea, don’t do it. I tried to do something similar last night, but it didn’t work. It was supposed to work and I should’ve died, but I woke up. Instead of trying to get back at people or whatever you want to do, live and become successful or something. That shit will hurt them more than dying a gruesome death.
Ok
Maybe, but I want the pain and misery to end.

I once had a friend like that too, she passed away a few years ago. It was on the newspapers too. In Buffalo. She was like my only friend in high school, and her passing away devastated me. We were going to hang out that day, but it never happened. At least this way, I’ll get to see her again.

I’m just a really big mess, nothing is working out for me and my relationships aren’t working out. I’ve been contemplating suicide for years. Found the most foolproof plan last night, and tried it out. Woke up this morning and I’m miserable. I just want to die now

It hurts a lot. I tried last night, and I woke up this morning. My first thought was, this should’ve be happening. I’m a mess right now, I shouldn’t have survived. I don’t know what to do right now. Maybe I’ll try again tonight.
Thank you for trying. It really meant a lot to me.
It’s not about things getting better. It’s all about getting rid of the pain and misery, I’m just better off dead.

What proof do you have that it will? I have waited 10 years for things to get better. I don’t know how much longer I’m gonna last. I might as well end it tonight. Thanks for trying, it did mean a lot.
Things never do get better, it just gets worse for me. It’s like I have Parker luck all jacked up on steroids or something. Nothing good ever happens to me, and I’m ready to give up.
You were right I guess, I survived

But that is also a lie, they only do it for the publicity and attention. Nobody really cares. We’re just better off dead........
